themes.title: Anthropic IPO lifts risk appetite
themes.summary: Bitcoin recovered toward $64,000 as Nasdaq 100 futures rose nearly 2% ahead of Anthropic's record IPO; an FxPro analyst said IPO money could flow back into crypto (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Seventh weekly loss in view
themes.summary: Bitcoin is on track for a seventh straight weekly decline, which would be its second-longest losing streak after nine weeks in 2022, and trades more than 7% below its 200-week moving average (CoinDesk).

themes.title: ETF outflows deepen
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have seen about $2.9 billion of net outflows so far in November, up from about $500 million in October, per CoinDesk (CoinDesk).

themes.title: Fed hike weighs on crypto
themes.summary: October Fed minutes showed most officials expected further rate increases, and markets price a December quarter-point hike as highly likely (CoinDesk; KuCoin).

themes.title: Sentiment at extreme fear
themes.summary: The Fear and Greed Index fell to 10 from 11 a day earlier and 55 a month ago, per Alternative.me data (CoinGabbar; KuCoin).
